qusanna-fi-liqii.title: Savings & Loan
qusanna-fi-liqii.subtitle: Savings & Loan
qusanna-fi-liqii.description: Save regularly and qualify for member loans. Mandatory and voluntary savings earn 7% for adults and 10.5% for children.
qusanna-fi-liqii.overview: Members can access loans by saving in different ways. Waliin pays 7% interest on mandatory and voluntary adult savings and 10.5% on children's savings.

subTypes.name: Mandatory Savings
subTypes.desc: Members save 500 ETB every month continuously. Mandatory savings can only be withdrawn when membership is ended.

subTypes.name: Voluntary Savings
subTypes.desc: Members may save any amount they choose with the cooperative and can withdraw it at any time.

subTypes.name: Children's Savings
subTypes.desc: Children can save money through their parents or guardians. Children's savings start at 500 ETB.

subTypes.name: Productive Savings
subTypes.desc: Members who maintain 25% continuous savings for three to four months or more can access a productive loan.

qusanna-hawaasummaa.title: Social Savings
qusanna-hawaasummaa.subtitle: Social Savings
qusanna-hawaasummaa.description: Community-focused savings that unlock social loans based on your consistent 25% savings record.
qusanna-hawaasummaa.overview: Members who maintain 25% continuous savings can access a social loan. The loan limit depends on the savings tier.

qusannoo-daldalaa.title: Business Savings
qusannoo-daldalaa.subtitle: Business Savings & Loan
qusannoo-daldalaa.description: Grow your trade with business savings and loans tied to 30% continuous savings.
qusannoo-daldalaa.overview: Members who maintain 30% continuous savings can access a business loan. The loan limit depends on the savings tier.

qusannoo-manaa.title: Housing Savings
qusannoo-manaa.subtitle: Housing Savings & Loan
qusannoo-manaa.description: Save toward renovating, building, or buying a home with housing credit up to ETB 2 million.
qusannoo-manaa.overview: Members who maintain 30% continuous savings for six months or more can access a housing loan.

qusannoo-konkolaataa.title: Vehicle Savings
qusannoo-konkolaataa.subtitle: Vehicle Loan
qusannoo-konkolaataa.description: Purchase a vehicle after six months of 30% continuous savings, with limits up to ETB 2 million.
qusannoo-konkolaataa.overview: Members who maintain 30% continuous savings for six months or more can access a vehicle purchase loan.

tiers.label: Buy a vehicle
tiers.condition: 30% savings continuously for 6 months or more

qusannoo-baajaajii.title: Bajaj Savings
qusannoo-baajaajii.subtitle: Bajaj / Tuk-Tuk Loan
qusannoo-baajaajii.description: Finance a three-wheeler for livelihood after 4–6 months of 30% savings, up to ETB 1 million.
qusannoo-baajaajii.overview: Members who save 30% continuously for four to six months or more can access a bajaj loan to buy a three-wheeler.

qusannoo-liqii-mindaa.title: Salary Loan Savings
qusannoo-liqii-mindaa.subtitle: Salary Advance Loan
qusannoo-liqii-mindaa.description: Salary-backed credit for employed members, including emergency advances of up to four months' net pay.
qusannoo-liqii-mindaa.overview: Members employed by different organizations can access an emergency loan of up to four months of net salary when urgent needs arise.

tiers.label: Emergency loan
tiers.condition: 25% savings continuously for 2 months (for employed members)

tiers.label: Regular loan
tiers.condition: 25% savings continuously for 4 months or more

qusannaa-oogeesootaa.title: Professional Savings
qusannaa-oogeesootaa.subtitle: Professional Savings & Loan
qusannaa-oogeesootaa.description: Credit for experienced professionals starting or expanding a practice after five or more years of service.
qusannaa-oogeesootaa.overview: Members with five or more years of professional service can use their experience to start or expand their own institution or business.

tiers.label: Experienced professionals
tiers.condition: 5+ years of service and 25% savings for 5 months or more
